verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled actions, such as auto-forwarding on a set cadence, are a plausible capability for a virtual mailbox service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only one-off, manually requested actions (scan, forward, shred) and the ability to schedule a single pickup day and time. Nothing documents recurring jobs or automated workflows, and the probes found no API or OpenAPI spec that could be used for scheduling.
